descriptionText:
This Treylon Burks RC 2022 Select Draft Picks Field Level Rookie card is a must-have for any National Football League (NFL) fan. The card features a standard size and is manufactured by Select. It is a parallel/variety card with a blue design, and it is part of the 2022 Select set. 

The card showcases the player's name, team, and card number (106). It is a sports trading card that highlights the athlete's rookie status and the team's colors. The card is not autographed, and it was manufactured in the United States. This is a great addition to any collection, and it is perfect for fans of the Arkansas Razorbacks and Tennessee Titans.
